served_reply:
The comparison cannot put an option forward because the total-investment constraint was not checkable in this model.

• All four routes were included, including the £15,000/£15,000 split; the original two routes still use £20,000 over six months.
• The run is only moderately stable: changing the assumed release-to-adoption or adoption-to-MRR relationships can change the ordering tested.
• No single assumption measurably changed the ordering in the sensitivity test, but 24 underlying values remain Olumi estimates rather than your evidence.

The model needs a checkable definition of total investment before its budget constraint can support the comparison.
